Usage: probe [options] [command]

commander probe

Options:
  -f, --force          skip confirmation prompts
  -n, --limit <n>      maximum number of results to return, a deliberately long
                       description so commander has to wrap it onto continuation
                       lines
  --dry-run            print what would change
  -v, --verbose        increase verbosity
  -o, --output [file]  write output here (optional value)
  --no-color           disable color
  -h, --help           display help for command

Commands:
  sub                  a subcommand
  help [command]       display help for command
